model.name: Close the auth gaps the tests leaned on
model.description: CREATE_ROOM and JOIN_ROOM take the identity from msg.playerToken instead of the connection's own identity; a bare token logs a user in; the SystemTester token is public in the repo. Tests depended on all three.
model.poDirective: Tron 2026-11-22: radical consolidation of test users and CI, run by a separate Claude Code agent (not the oopTeam fleet).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CREATE_ROOM/JOIN_ROOM use the connection's authenticated identity and reject a different playerToken.

gateRef.assertion: a test sending a foreign playerToken is refused

acceptanceCriteria.text: A bare token no longer logs a user in; device-key login is required.

gateRef.assertion: IDENTIFY with only a token → not authenticated

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test and owner tokens are out of the repo and the public ones are rotated.

gateRef.assertion: grep the repo for the old tokens → 0 hits
